substitutions.reason: Highest stable construct-library release on npm at resolution time (npm view aws-cdk-lib version => 2.260.0), superseding the design baseline 2.258.0. Anchors the peer-constraint graph for both apps (Req 1.1).

CLI versions independently from the library since Feb 2025; selected the latest published CLI (npm view aws-cdk version => 2.1128.0), which is compatible with aws-cdk-lib 2.260.0. Supersedes design note 2.1031.1 (Req 1.2).
Pinned character-for-character to the selected aws-cdk-lib (2.260.0) per the alpha-suffix convention; confirmed published on npm. Exact-pin style preserved (Req 1.3, 1.5).
Latest constructs 10.x (npm view constructs version => 10.6.0). Caret range preserved; satisfies aws-cdk-lib ^10 and cdk-nag 2.38.2 (constructs ^10.0.5) (Req 1.4).

Selected the highest cdk-nag 2.x (2.38.2; peers aws-cdk-lib ^2.176.0, constructs ^10.0.5 — satisfied by 2.260.0). cdk-nag 3.0.1 is published and peer-compatible, but a major-version bump risks new/changed rule behavior against the behavior-preservation constraint (Req 16); deferred to maintainer review rather than adopted automatically. Exact-pin style preserved (Req 1.5, 1.6).
Latest stable TypeScript 5.9 (npm view typescript@5 version => 5.9.3). Tilde range preserved; supports the ES2023 target (Req 1.4, 3.4).
Pinned within the Node 22 line (npm view @types/node@^22 version => 22.20.0) to match the engines lower bound (>=22.0.0). Caret style preserved (Req 1.4).
Latest stable Flask 3.1 on PyPI (3.1.3); exact pin per Req 6.1–6.2.
Latest stable boto3 on PyPI (1.43.34), superseding the design baseline 1.40.x; no known advisory. Exact pin per Req 6.1–6.2.
Latest stable Psycopg 3.3 on PyPI (3.3.4); [binary,pool] extras preserved. Exact pin per Req 6.1–6.2.
python-jose is effectively unmaintained; PyJWT is actively maintained. Latest stable PyJWT on PyPI (2.13.0), superseding the design baseline 2.10.x. Exact pin per Req 6.1–6.3.
Latest stable code-server GitHub release (v4.125.0), superseding the design baseline 4.105.1. Pinned exactly in the bootstrap template (Req 17.6, 17.11).

Latest AL2023-based standard x86_64 managed image per CodeBuild docs (ec2-compute-images: :5.0 and :6.0 are both AL2023; :6.0 is the newest standard tag), superseding the design baseline :5.0 (Req 17.7, 17.11).

engineDecision.basis: Highest non-EOL Aurora PostgreSQL 15.x minor present in the aws-cdk-lib 2.260.0 AuroraPostgresEngineVersion enum (verified: enum members VER_15_2..VER_15_17, highest 15.x = VER_15_17). Remaining within major 15 preserves tenant SQL behavior.

bootstrapElements.constraintNote: Public "latest" SSM parameters self-resolve to currently supported AMIs; no static change required (Req 17.8).

maintainerConstraints.subject: Lambda Python runtime (LambdaFunctionConstruct.ts)
maintainerConstraints.detail: Runtime.PYTHON_3_13 retained. 3.13 is current and non-deprecated; the in-scope defect is the Flask container mismatch, so the minimal behavior-preserving fix keeps 3.13 and aligns the container to it. Python 3.14 (GA in Lambda, Nov 2025) is an OPTIONAL forward move requiring maintainer confirmation; not adopted automatically.

maintainerConstraints.subject: cdk-nag major version (2.x -> 3.x)
maintainerConstraints.detail: cdk-nag 3.0.1 is published and peer-compatible with aws-cdk-lib 2.260.0 (peers: aws-cdk-lib ^2.257.0, constructs ^10.5.1), but the major bump can introduce new/changed nag rules that alter findings. Selected 2.38.2 (latest 2.x) to preserve behavior; adopting 3.x is deferred to maintainer review.
